Class StaticCompilationHints

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.python.processing.staticcompile.StaticCompilationHints
public final class StaticCompilationHints extends Object
What an author can change so that a function the planner refused is compiled: one suggestion per reason rule, sharpened by the message of the reason where one rule covers several situations. The report prints the suggestion next to every reason.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Graeme Rocher
